tables.caption: Method positioning. ✓/-- indicate presence/absence of each property. Graph-based retrieval uses inter-item graph relations during retrieval. LLM-free graph initialization constructs the initial graph without LLM calls; -- also denotes methods without graph initialization. SkillGraph uses teacher-generated skill nodes even though its initial edges follow fixed rules. SE-GoS refers to the primary semantic-only initialization. Execution-driven updates use execution traces or outcomes to update system state. Training-free excludes neural-weight training of either the agent or retriever. Skill selection chooses library skills for the current task, whether or not their content is also edited. Edge-weight updates adapt numerical relation weights from feedback. Retrieval-description updates optimize descriptions for retrieval while leaving source skill content unchanged. Rows describe the original methods: MemRL retrieves episodic memories, and SkillOpt optimizes a shared skill document. Our experimental MemRL* adaptation selects skills.

Main results. R: reward (%), T: input tokens (M), S: runtime (s). Bold/underline mark best/second-best for each backbone and benchmark. MemRL* denotes our adaptation of MemRL's episodic-memory retrieval to skill retrieval.

Held-out performance and paired comparisons. Metrics follow Table tab:main. Bold/underline mark best/second-best in (a). MemRL* denotes our adaptation of MemRL's episodic-memory retrieval to skill retrieval. W/T/L denote task-level wins/ties/losses in (b).

Component ablations and structural controls on full87 (n=174 per cell). The first eight rows share the semantic-only cold start. The last two modify full SE-GoS. Metrics follow Table tab:main. Bold/underline mark best/second-best.

Execution support for first-round workflow edges. Query observations count qualifying retrieval queries and determine induced workflow weights. Distinct-task support measures how many tasks supply that evidence, counting each task once.

Evolution from two initializations. Reward (%) and evolved graph statistics, using each initial graph's own trajectories. All graphs have 1,000 nodes. Node edits count changed retrieval descriptions. Sem./Work./Dep./Alt. denote semantic/workflow/dependency/alternative edges; dependency and alternative edges are inherited.
Multi-round evolution (174 attempts per round). All graphs contain 1,000 nodes and no alternative edges. Node edits count description updates within each round. Metrics follow Table tab:main.
Hyperparameters of the primary SE-GoS configuration. Baseline differences are listed in Table tab:protocol_comparison.
SkillsBench held-out partition by domain. Evolution tasks supply execution feedback for graph updates. Held-out tasks evaluate the frozen graphs. The same partition is used for SE-GoS and SkillDAG.
Avoid-filtering diagnostics on retrieval queries recorded in evaluation trajectories. A task or attempt is affected if filtering changes the skill bundle for at least one of its queries.
Held-out avoid-filtering ablation (n=74 attempts per condition).
